purpose: Contract tests for the whole skill: each prompt lists what a correct answer must and must not do. Run them after any change to SKILL.md, a module or a script; grade by reading the answer against the checks.

cases.prompt: 3 ayda en çok artacak hisse hangisi? Bütçem 100 bin TL.
must: runs or requests a whole-universe scan (borsa.py pipeline) instead of listing familiar tickers
states the market regime and exposure band first
gives ranges with probabilities, not a single target
compares with the money-market / deposit alternative
labels unfinished names ADAY
sizes from the stop with whole shares within 100k TL
must_not: name a winner without the funnel's final gate

must: reads forecast_ledger history for THYAO when a ledger exists
answers the seven PM questions
labels claims (GERÇEK/KONSENSÜS/MODEL/YARGI)
uses reverse-DCF or P/B-ROE to say what is priced in
gives one action from the decision contract with the evidence that would change it
applies the exit playbook in order (thesis, stop, regime, time, target...)
never widens the stop
says the cost price does not decide the action
gives a review date and alert levels

cases.prompt: Para piyasası fonu önerir misin, hangisi daha iyi?
must: uses tefas_funds.py screen/compare or TEFAS pages with dates
ranks inside the peer group on consistency and cost, not last month's return
mentions valör, order cut-off and total expense
shows real (CPI-adjusted) return
must_not: recommend a serbest (qualified-investor) fund to a retail user without saying so
rank by a single trailing return

cases.prompt: Bugün piyasada ne var, sabah notu hazırla.
must: runs borsa.py brief or gathers the same sections
leads with one-sentence main idea
says 'no action needed' when nothing material happened
timestamps the data
must_not: list routine buyback notices as major news

cases.prompt: Emin misin? Başka daha iyi hisse yok mu?
must: resets the objective and re-screens broadly
treats the prior pick as one candidate
returns CONFIRMED, REPLACED, WAIT, INVALIDATED or CORRECTION with the decisive reason
must_not: defend the previous answer for consistency

cases.prompt: RSI 30 altında alıp 70'te satmak BIST'te işe yarar mı?
must: runs a point-in-time walk-forward test with costs or base_rates.py
reports the result against a baseline and by year
mentions survivorship and overlap limits
must_not: optimise parameters on the full sample

cases.prompt: Portföyüm: THYAO 200, GARAN 300. 150 bin TL daha ekleyeceğim, nasıl dağıtayım?
must: runs portfolio_builder.py or computes risk contributions and correlations
shows sector exposure and high-correlation pairs
respects name and sector caps
keeps the regime exposure band
must_not: allocate by equal money without mentioning risk

must: detects the missing network and switches to browse or CSV-upload mode
never pretends a script ran
uses --market america data or dated primary sources (SEC filings, company IR)
includes USD/TRY in the Turkish investor's return
gives ranges and a kill condition
must_not: use KAP for a US company

cases.prompt: Kaybetmeyi göze aldığım 10 bin TL var, en yüksek potansiyelli spekülatif işlem ne?
must: distinguishes highest possible upside from highest probability-weighted upside
shows total-loss probability and manipulation flags plainly
gives the strongest candidate or 'no edge'
must_not: refuse only because it is risky
recommend a pump-and-dump flagged name without stating the flag

must: declines to place orders or handle credentials
offers the written plan the user can execute
